completed_this_run: Added a four-worker bounded silent catalog validator with ordered credential-safe JSON results.
Added a daily and manually dispatchable GitHub Actions sweep retaining reports for 30 days.
Classified transient HTTP statuses separately from permanent endpoint rejection.
Replaced the retired Left Coast 70s stream URL with SomaFM's publisher-listed MP3 M3U endpoint.
Final live sweep decoded 25 of 25 catalog stations.
Added one delayed retry for transient unavailable reports; permanent rejections remain single-attempt.
Added opt-in atomic 64 KiB feed-health history with freshness and consecutive failure state.
Added host API to import saved feed evidence into the GUI with live-result precedence and no playback gating.
Added a shared versioned fixture consumed by CLI and GUI tests to prevent the persisted schema from drifting.
Strictly validate saved-history status, stage, freshness, timestamps, attempts and counters in both the CLI rewriter and GUI importer.
Normalize transport errors without a stage to not_checked so persisted history remains importable.
Moved versioned feed-history parsing and freshness recomputation into rust-radio-core and re-exported the API from the headless facade.
Reused the core parser from CLI persistence and GUI saved-history import, removing duplicate schema validation.
Added a headless embedding contract test proving saved history is readable without GUI or I/O.
Reconciled IP PlaybackStarted snapshots with actual native callback sample consumption, including delayed callbacks and per-retry counters.
Extended callback-consumed status reconciliation to direct nRSP-native, SDRconnect and Soapy playback; clear failed attempt progress before recovery.
Extracted native output full-ring callback watchdog logic and added deterministic no-callback failure and cancellation classification regressions.
Added compact station category label chosen by three-variant A/B/C measurement; all 25 curated labels fit at 295px while retaining genre cues.
Strengthened the layout regression to prove non-WCRB category labels remain unchanged; GUI crate tests and strict Clippy passed.

Enforced exactly one process-wide native playback worker across NativeRadioEngine instances with an atomic RAII lease; a second start is rejected before resource opening and release is covered for normal exit and unwinding.
Strengthened the process-wide playback admission regression to cover both public curated-station and direct-stream start APIs; both reject a second worker before resource opening.

Classified IP format-probe I/O errors as audio-output failure when CPAL has reported device loss; this prevents spending network retry budget on a failed output while preserving network recovery for ordinary probe I/O.

Added bounded recovery for direct nRSP-ST active-stream transport errors and inactivity timeouts while preserving terminal startup/activation failures; retries restore the latest requested tuning and FM settings.

Extracted direct nRSP retry sequencing into recover_nrsp_attempts and added an offline fixture that verifies bounded delay, one retry, output-progress clearing, reconnect mode, and restoration of latest tuning/FM settings.
